title: Two-Tape Action Encoding
statement: For a natural number $n$ and an action of a two-work-tape machine with Boolean alphabet and state set of size $n+1$, encode its data as a Boolean list: the input-head movement, then the write option and head movement for each work tape in order, then the optional output symbol, and finally the optional successor state.
